title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Sênior (Governança e GRC)
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF

Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina; da Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, fazedores e convictos da importância de levar o movimento para cada vez mais gente. Se você se move por esporte, ou é movido por ele, temos um convite: que tal também trabalhar por ele?

Ficou interessado(a)? Vem saber mais!


Dia a dia:

Foco: Governança, Riscos, Controles e Regulamentações

Atuar de forma estratégica no fortalecimento da governança de Segurança da Informação, assegurando aderência a regulamentações, frameworks e normas aplicáveis (LGPD, PCI DSS, ISO 27001/27002, NIST, entre outras), promovendo gestão eficaz de riscos, controles internos e conformidade regulatória em alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades:


Governança e Compliance

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter políticas, normas e procedimentos de Segurança da Informação.
  • Garantir aderência a frameworks como ISO 27001/27002, NIST CSF, CIS Controls e PCI DSS.
  • Apoiar e conduzir auditorias internas e externas.
  • Atuar na sustentação de certificações e avaliações regulatórias.
  • Apoiar o programa de adequação e sustentação à LGPD.
  • Apoiar na avaliação de Privacy by Design e Security by Design.


Gestão de Riscos e Controles

  • Conduzir análises de riscos de segurança (técnicos, operacionais e regulatórios).
  • Definir, implementar e monitorar controles internos de segurança.
  • Avaliar riscos de terceiros e fornecedores críticos.
  • Elaborar planos de tratamento de riscos e acompanhar sua execução.
  • Manter matriz de riscos atualizada e integrada à estratégia corporativa.


Regulamentações e Normas

  • Atuar nos temas relacionados a PCI DSS.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos regulatórios (LGPD, normas contratuais).
  • Traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos e processuais aplicáveis.
  • Apoiar áreas de negócio na interpretação de requisitos de segurança.


Integração com Áreas Internas

  • Trabalhar em parceria com Jurídico, Compliance, Auditoria, Tecnologia, Privacidade e áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar comitês de risco e segurança.
  • Contribuir com indicadores, dashboards executivos e relatórios estratégicos.


Perfil Esperado

  • Visão estratégica de segurança alinhada ao negócio.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Security Engineer to own and scale security across a fast-growing cloud-native platform. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who combines strong engineering fundamentals with practical, real-world security experience.

You will be responsible for securing infrastructure, applications, CI/CD pipelines, and third-party integrations — while enabling engineering teams to move quickly and safely.


Responsibilities

  • Secure AWS infrastructure including IAM, RDS, networking, secrets management, and Terraform-managed resources
  • Strengthen security across serverless backends, APIs, and cloud services
  • Improve application security across web and mobile applications
  • Embed security into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows
  • Own logging, monitoring, alerting, and incident response processes
  • Conduct third-party vendor security reviews (e.g., payments, identity, infrastructure tools)
  • Support compliance readiness (e.g., SOC 2, GDPR) and assist with customer security reviews
  • Act as the internal security point of contact during growth and audits


Must Have

  • Strong engineering fundamentals (cloud, Linux, networking, APIs)
  • Hands-on AWS security experience
  • Deep understanding of web and API security (authentication, permissions, OWASP Top 10)
  • Experience handling production security incidents
  • Automation mindset (Python, scripting, infrastructure-as-code awareness)
  • Ability to balance risk pragmatically in a fast-moving startup environment
  • Fluent spoken English


Nice to Have

  • Experience securing serverless architectures
  • Exposure to payments, identity verification, or distributed systems
  • Startup or scale-up experience
  • Familiarity with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 frameworks


Role Details

  • Fully remote B2B
  • Contract role (12 months)
  • CET working hours
  • 300 USD per day

title: Senior Endpoint Security Automation Engineer
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Endpoint Security Automation Engineer to lead the design, development, and optimization of automated workflows for endpoint security event and issue management. This role will be responsible for integrating and automating processes across platforms such as ServiceNow, Microsoft Power BI, Data Hub, SIEM, and SOAR solutions.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in cybersecurity operations with strong automation, data integration, and process optimization skills. This role plays a critical part in improving detection-to-response time, enhancing operational visibility, and ensuring scalable and resilient endpoint security operations.

Design, implement, and maintain automated workflows for endpoint security event and issue management.

Integrate endpoint detection platforms with ServiceNow for automated ticket creation, enrichment, prioritization, and lifecycle management.

Develop dashboards and executive-level reporting using Microsoft Power BI to provide actionable security insights and KPIs.

Orchestrate data pipelines and security telemetry ingestion Data Hub or equivalent data integration technologies.

Design and optimize SIEM use cases and correlation rules to enhance endpoint threat detection.

Develop and maintain SOAR playbooks to automate triage, containment, remediation, and escalation processes.

Collaborate with SOC, Incident Response, Endpoint Engineering, and IT Operations teams to continuously improve automation and security processes.

Ensure proper documentation of automation workflows, integrations, and operational procedures.

Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing manual effort and increasing response efficiency.

Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior team members.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience).

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
DesignRush.com, a B2B Media Platform that drives brand discovery & growth, is seeking a Digital Marketing Manager to take ownership of the Design Awards section. We are seeking a qualified leader who can grow a specific section of the site and bring in results.


Our platform offers four key values to users:


  • Trending Brands: Brands can feature their expertise and achievements via news, interviews, and trends articles to get noticed and recognized as an industry leader.
  • Agency Rankings: Brands can view qualified agencies based on their expertise, location, clients, and various other factors.
  • Awards: Brands can enter their finest work and compete for the best web logo, app, print, packaging, and video design awards.
  • Marketplace: Businesses can post their projects at no cost and receive proposals from verified agencies.


The person in this role will be responsible for driving brand awareness, engagement, and revenue growth.


We offer GROWTH, job stability, and a work culture that enables our teammates to excel in their careers.


This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position.


DesignRush is seeking to make IMMEDIATE hires.


Responsibilities:


  • Ensure revenue growth for Design Awards
  • Own the performance of the Awards program by driving paid submissions, agency participation, sponsorships, partnerships, pricing models, and upsell opportunities among existing DesignRush clients.
  • Expand the Awards ecosystem globally by building relationships with design agencies and creative studios, developing partnerships with industry organizations, and coordinating outreach with Sales and Lead Generation teams.
  • Define and manage the Awards program strategy, including categories, evaluation structure, submission flow, jury selection, and positioning to strengthen credibility and align with the DesignRush media strategy.
  • Drive marketing and demand generation for the Awards by collaborating with Content, SEO, and social teams on amplification campaigns promoting nominees, winners, and award launches.
  • Optimize product systems and workflows supporting the Awards program by working with the Product team on submission dashboards, evaluation tools, automation, and cross-team operational processes.
  • Track and report program performance by monitoring submissions, revenue, agency engagement, and traffic, while building KPI dashboards and identifying growth opportunities through data analysis.
  • Work closely with team leaders to define marketing promotions, initiatives, and special offers


Required qualifications:


  • Over 5 years of proven hands-on experience as a marketing leader.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing and leading a team
  • Proven success with newsletter campaigns
  • Proven experience in B2B marketing
  • Experience working with design agencies or the creative industry
  • Experience managing awards, media platforms, or communities
  • Strong understanding of marketing, branding, and digital agencies
  • Excellent written and oral English communication skills
  • Goal-oriented individual
  • Strong ability to strategize and solve problems
  • Able to work between 6 AM and 3 PM EST


Recruitment steps:


  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • Receive a short questionnaire
  • Send back answers + CV
  • Have an interview with our Recruiter
  • Technical Test
  • Have an interview with our General Manager
  • Get feedback


We kindly ask for your CV and all correspondence to be in English.

title: Software Engineer in Test
description:
Quality Platform Engineer (Remote – Brazil, CLT)


QAT Global , a US-based IT consulting firm with 30+ years of experience , is looking for a Quality Platform Engineer to support a US-based customer.

You will collaborate with development teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil , building and operating the infrastructure that powers automated testing.


About the Role

We are looking for a Quality Platform Engineer to design, build, and operate the platform that executes automated testing at scale.

While Quality Engineers focus on writing tests, this role ensures those tests run reliably, efficiently, and consistently across environments .

You will work closely with QA, Engineering, and DevOps teams , owning the infrastructure and systems that power automated test execution.

This role also supports automation frameworks using Playwright and performance testing using JMeter .


Responsibilities:


  • Design and maintain containerized environments used for automated testing
  • Build and operate scalable test execution platforms supporting parallel and isolated test runs
  • Ensure consistent behavior across local, CI, and pre-release environments
  • Design and maintain GitHub Actions workflows for automated testing in the SDLC
  • Integrate automated testing into the release and deployment process
  • Support automation frameworks using Playwright and performance testing using JMeter
  • Improve reliability, performance, and observability of automated test pipelines
  • Build systems for test result aggregation, artifacts, and failure analysis
  • Identify and reduce test flakiness and pipeline instability
  • Enable Quality Engineers through clear execution interfaces and documentation


Required Experience:


  • Strong experience with CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions preferred)
  • Hands-on experience with Docker or container-based execution environments
  • Experience supporting automated test execution platforms or CI runners
  • Experience supporting automation frameworks such as Playwright
  • Experience supporting performance testing execution (JMeter preferred)
  • Strong scripting/programming skills (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Bash, or similar )
  • Solid understanding of modern software architectures and automated testing strategies
  • Experience with parallel test execution, test sharding, or ephemeral environments
  • Experience analyzing failures in CI pipelines or automated test runs
  • Comfortable working across QA, DevOps, and Engineering teams
  • Strong English communication skills


Preferred Qualifications:


  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering , or related field

title: Senior Database Engineer / Lead DBA (DB2 LUW & Cloud Migration) – Bilingual (EN/PT)
description:
We are hiring for a USA company:


Senior Database Engineer / Lead DBA (DB2 LUW & Cloud Migration) – Bilingual (EN/PT)


About the Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Database Administrator (DBA) to join our Global Mainframe DB2 LUW team. This is not a typical application development role; we are looking for a \"under-the-hood\" expert who understands database internals, performance optimization, and the complexities of migrating data between NoSQL and Relational environments.

As a technical lead, you will manage high-stakes backend operations, automate audit compliance, and guide the team through complex data mapping and environment refreshes.

What You Will Do

  • Core Administration: Perform deep-dive backend management of DB2 LUW (Linux, Unix, Windows) environments.
  • Environment Management: Execute test environment refreshes and manage data flow from Archive (AR) environments into active test streams.
  • Modernization & Migration: Lead the charge in migrating data from NoSQL to Relational databases, focusing on complex data mapping, relationship building, and schema design.
  • Cloud & NoSQL: Manage tasks related to AWS RDS and NoSQL platforms, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Automation & Compliance: Develop automation scripts for audit compliance and security protocols.
  • Performance Tuning: Act as the subject matter expert for advanced SQL tuning and database optimization.
  • Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and leadership to junior and mid-level engineers.

Required Qualifications

  • Language: Native or professional fluency in both English and Portuguese is mandatory.
  • Mainframe DB2 LUW
  • Expertise in DB2 LUW: Extensive experience in backend DB2 LUW administration (not just interfacing via apps).
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record of migrating data between different architectures (Relational vs. NoSQL).
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with Amazon RDS and NoSQL databases.
  • Advanced Tuning: Expert-level ability to diagnose and resolve complex SQL performance issues.
  • Location: Remote friendly—we value your skillset over your physical location.

title: Tech Systems Analyst
description:
We are looking for a strong Java Application Support Engineer to join our global Financial Services application support team, made up of team members in the United States, Brazil, and India. This position will sit remotely in Brazil. In this role, you will monitor, troubleshoot, deploy, and debug existing applications. Relational Database experience with SQL, MySQL, Oracle SQL, or PL/SQL experience is preferred. Deployment experience using Jenkins is highly preferred. Our team works in an Agile Scrum environment with daily stand-ups and sprint meetings. You will be a part of an on-call rotation once you are trained on our applications.


Responsibilities:

  • Java application support
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, deploy, and debug existing applications
  • Debug software components, identify, fix, and verify remediation of code defects (own work and the work of others)
  • Support and maintain projects developed by the team and assist in production deployment and outages
  • Configure, deploy, debug, monitor, and document new system features and enhancements using Jenkins
  • Successfully communicate designs, research, and potential issues with team members
  • Collaborate with business professionals to determine functional and non-functional requirements for software development projects.
  • Participate in rotational 24x7 on-call 3rd/4th level support


Qualifications:

  • Associate Degree, or, Technologo (Technologist) Degree, or higher is required.
  • 4+ Years of Java/J2EE application support experience
  • 2+ years of Relational Database experience
  • 2+ years of CI/CD tools (Jenkins)
  • 2+ years of experience on Linux platform
  • Good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming and Design principles
  • Knowledge of the full lifecycle of software development including use of version control tools, build management, unit testing, issue tracking software (e.g. SVN, Git, Maven, Jenkins, JIRA)
  • Excellent organizational skills, self-administration, attention to detail, multi-tasking, and effective prioritization
  • Strong interpersonal and English communication skills
  • Self-motivated and able to meet objectives
  • Experience with the following technologies preferred:
  • Spring/Spring-MVC/Spring Batch/Spring Boot is a plus
  • Tomcat, JBoss
  • REST Services, SOAP Services
  • Relational Database experience
  • JIRA & Confluence
  • Dynatrace & Splunk

title: Tech Systems Analyst
description:
We are looking for a strong Java Application Support Engineer to join our global Financial Services application support team, made up of team members in the United States, Brazil, and India. This position will sit remotely in Brazil. In this role, you will monitor, troubleshoot, deploy, and debug existing applications. Relational Database experience with SQL, MySQL, Oracle SQL, or PL/SQL experience is preferred. Deployment experience using Jenkins is highly preferred. Our team works in an Agile Scrum environment with daily stand-ups and sprint meetings. You will be a part of an on-call rotation once you are trained on our applications.


Responsibilities:

  • Java application support
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, deploy, and debug existing applications
  • Debug software components, identify, fix, and verify remediation of code defects (own work and the work of others)
  • Support and maintain projects developed by the team and assist in production deployment and outages
  • Configure, deploy, debug, monitor, and document new system features and enhancements using Jenkins
  • Successfully communicate designs, research, and potential issues with team members
  • Collaborate with business professionals to determine functional and non-functional requirements for software development projects.
  • Participate in rotational 24x7 on-call 3rd/4th level support


Qualifications:

  • Associate Degree, or, Technologo (Technologist) Degree, or higher is required.
  • 4+ Years of Java/J2EE application support experience
  • 2+ years of Relational Database experience
  • 2+ years of CI/CD tools (Jenkins)
  • 2+ years of experience on Linux platform
  • Good understanding of Object-Oriented Programming and Design principles
  • Knowledge of the full lifecycle of software development including use of version control tools, build management, unit testing, issue tracking software (e.g. SVN, Git, Maven, Jenkins, JIRA)
  • Excellent organizational skills, self-administration, attention to detail, multi-tasking, and effective prioritization
  • Strong interpersonal and English communication skills
  • Self-motivated and able to meet objectives
  • Experience with the following technologies preferred:
  • Spring/Spring-MVC/Spring Batch/Spring Boot is a plus
  • Tomcat, JBoss
  • REST Services, SOAP Services
  • Relational Database experience
  • JIRA & Confluence
  • Dynatrace & Splunk

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
Project Description:

  • One of the world's largest providers of products and services to the energy industry has a need to develop, support and integrate software system in Oil & Gas domain.
  • You will be a member of a cross functional team.
  • Key project stakeholders are open for innovative ideas.
  • Project is based on SCRUM methodology.
  • This is a great opportunity to work in an international team, apply and learn modern IT technologies


Responsibilities:

  • Application Security with strong AI/ML security exposure
  • Threat modeling and risk assessment for AI systems, APIs, and cloud-native applications
  • Protection against prompt injection, adversarial ML, data poisoning, and model abuse
  • Secure SDLC and CI/CD integration, including MLOps pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning, and security automation
  • Strong collaboration with development and data science teams


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 5+ years in Application Security, with at least 1-2 years focused on AI/ML security
  • Strong secure coding and vulnerability management background (OWASP Top 10)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure)
  • Strong programming skills in Python or Java
  • Familiarity with AI platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, or Spark
  • Strong communication skills


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory services
  • Firewall and security group administration practical experience.
  • Good understanding of AICPA SOC2 controls and processes.
  • Thorough knowledge of network security and protocols.
  • Knowledge of cryptography protocols and hands-on experience in SSL certificates generation.
  • Penetration testing hands-on experience in Azure and AWS cloud environments and Kubernetes clusters.
  • Web and desktop applications penetration testing hands-on experience.


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Systems Analyst – Application Support
description:
Position: Systems Analyst – Application Support (Agribusiness)


Professional Profile: Experienced professional in system support, business analysis, problem-solving, and user assistance. Results-oriented, with a client- and business-focused approach.


Main Responsibilities

  • Provide support for applications related to agribusiness and tax document messaging (SEFAZ).
  • Analyze and identify bugs, operational failures, and incident root causes.
  • Log and report bugs, as well as suggest process and system improvements.
  • Develop queries and reports in PL/SQL (low and medium complexity).
  • Collaborate with internal IT teams for joint problem resolution.
  • Manage service priorities according to urgency and impact.
  • Work aligned with project methodologies and client guidelines.


Behavioral Competencies

  • Customer focus
  • Good communication
  • Proactivity
  • Teamwork
  • Ability to work under pressure
  • Meeting deadlines with quality
  • Risk identification and mitigation
  • Organization and prioritization


Languages

  • Intermediate English (emphasis on reading and writing); desirable comprehension and conversation.


Availability

• Availability to work night shifts on a 12x36 rotation, according to operational needs.

title: Analista Sênior de IAM
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista Sênior de IAM (gestão de identidade e acesso)



Resumo:

Estamos buscando um Analista Sênior de IAM experiente para se juntar à nossa equipe de cibersegurança. Este profissional será responsável por criar processos, configurar ferramentas e aprimorar os assuntos de IAM de forma global.

O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com outras frentes de segurança, infraestrutura, sistemas e equipes de negócios, avaliando as melhorias e implementações necessárias para a eficácia do Programa de IAM.



Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter processos de gestão de identidades e acessos, incluindo provisionamento, revogação e revisão periódica de privilégios;
  • Administrar e implementar ferramentas relacionadas à IAM garantindo funcionamento, confiabilidade e atendendo aos requisitos de segurança;
  • Criar, revisar e otimizar regras, perfis, grupos e políticas de acesso, assegurando a aplicação de princípio de privilégio mínimo e SoD (Segregação de Funções), para ambientes on prem e cloud;
  • Definir estratégia para integração de sistemas e aplicações às plataformas de IAM;
  • Colaborar com outros times para mapear processos de acesso, identificar riscos e sugerir implementações ou automações de controles;
  • Apoiar times internos na compreensão das práticas de gestão de identidades, acessos e requisitos de segurança relacionados;
  • Suportar processos de auditorias.




Requisitos Técnicos e Experiência:

  • Experiência de ao menos 5 anos atuando diretamente com temas ligados à IAM;
  • Formação Superior em Tecnologia da Informação/Segurança da Informação;
  • Conhecimento avançado em temas como AD/Entra ID, LDAP, SAML, OAuth, SSO, MFA, PAM, SoD, RBAC, princípio de menor privilégio e revisão de acessos;
  • Administração ou vivência em projetos de implementação de ferramentas de IDM(Identity Manager);
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Defender for Identity, e demais ferramentas de IAM para ambientes híbridos e multicloud (On Prem, Azure, AWS, GCP);
  • Fluência em inglês;
  • Conhecimento em normas e boas práticas de segurança da informação (ex: ISO 27001, NIST, etc).




Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Certificações relevantes de fabricantes de soluções para IAM/PAM, exemplo:

(CyberArk, Senha Segura, BeyondTrust, SailPoint, Okta, Microsoft EntraID, etc).




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Director of Marketing | Hotel Technology Experience Required
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next-generation, AI-native platform for the hospitality industry. Looking for a Director of Marketing who understands hotels, understands technology, and knows how to turn that knowledge into real growth.


This role is ideal for someone who has marketed to hotel decision-makers before and enjoys building campaigns, writing compelling content, and generating measurable demand.


About the Role

We’re building something special for the hotel industry, and we’re looking for a Director of Marketing who feels at home in the world of hotel technology.


If you’ve spent meaningful time marketing to hoteliers, understand how hotel decision-makers think, and enjoy rolling up your sleeves to create campaigns that drive pipeline, you’ll thrive in this role.


This is a hands-on, full-funnel leadership role responsible for building and scaling our marketing engine. You will oversee demand generation, product marketing, content creation, and go-to-market strategy while working closely with Sales to drive qualified leads and revenue growth.


The hospitality industry values clarity, trust, and solutions that make operations easier. We’re looking for someone who knows how to communicate exactly that.


What You’ll Be Doing

Develop a deep understanding of the hotel ecosystem, including independent hotels, management companies, and brand-affiliated properties.


Stay closely connected to the needs and priorities of hotel decision-makers such as:

  • General Managers
  • Directors of Sales and Marketing
  • Revenue Managers
  • Digital marketing leaders
  • IT leaders


Use these insights to shape messaging, positioning, and campaigns that resonate with hotel operators.


Owning the Marketing Engine

Build and manage the full marketing funnel—from awareness through lead generation, nurturing, and conversion to sales.


Key areas include:

  • Demand generation strategy
  • SEO and digital acquisition
  • Email and lifecycle marketing
  • Webinars and industry events
  • Campaign development and execution


Your goal is to ensure marketing consistently generates qualified pipeline for the sales team.


Leading Blog and Thought Leadership Strategy

Own and grow the company’s blog and thought leadership presence to establish authority in the hospitality technology space and drive inbound demand.


This includes:

  • Writing and overseeing blog content focused on hotel industry trends and insights
  • Creating thought leadership around topics like AI in hospitality, guest engagement, and direct booking strategies
  • Developing SEO-driven blog content that attracts hotel decision-makers researching solutions
  • Implement AI Engine Optimization (AEO) strategies to ensure the company and its content are discoverable through AI agents like Copilot, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other emerging AI-driven discovery platforms.
  • Repurposing blog content into campaigns, LinkedIn posts, webinars, and sales materials


Creating Content That Speaks the Hotel Industry’s Language

Develop and oversee content that resonates with hospitality leaders, including:

  • Blog articles and thought leadership pieces
  • Industry guides and educational resources
  • Case studies and ROI stories
  • Campaign messaging and landing pages
  • Sales enablement materials


The goal is content that feels authentic, practical, and directly relevant to hotel operators , while positioning the company as a trusted voice in hospitality technology.


Becoming Deeply Fluent in the Product

You will develop strong product knowledge and become fluent in how the platform works.


This includes understanding:

  • How the product integrates into the hotel technology stack
  • The operational problems it solves for hotel teams
  • The value it creates for revenue growth and guest engagement


This fluency will help shape messaging, positioning, and product launches.


Partnering Closely with Sales

Marketing and sales alignment is critical in this role.


You will work closely with the sales team to:

  • Align on pipeline and growth targets
  • Develop campaigns that generate qualified opportunities
  • Support sales with content, messaging, and materials
  • Continuously improve lead quality and funnel performance


Using Data to Drive Decisions

Track performance across the funnel and continuously improve marketing efficiency.


You will analyze:

  • Lead generation performance
  • Campaign ROI
  • Funnel conversion metrics
  • Customer acquisition trends


Marketing should be measurable, predictable, and scalable.


Success in This Role

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to build a scalable marketing engine that consistently generates qualified pipeline.


Key outcomes include:

  • Growth in marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline
  • Consistent generation of qualified leads for the sales team
  • Increased inbound demand through SEO, blog content, and thought leadership
  • Strong campaign performance across webinars, events, and digital channels
  • Clear and compelling positioning that resonates with hotel decision-makers


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience marketing to hotels or within the hospitality technology ecosystem
  • Experience in B2B SaaS marketing and demand generation
  • Proven ability to generate qualified pipeline and measurable revenue impact
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, including blogs and thought leadership content
  • Ability to translate complex technology into clear, compelling messaging
  • Comfort operating both strategically and hands-on
  • Experience collaborating closely with sales teams in a pipeline-driven environment
  • Interest in AI-driven platforms, automation, and emerging technology transforming hospitality


Experience at or working with hospitality technology platforms such as hotel CRM, guest engagement, marketing automation, revenue management, or hotel operations platforms is highly valued.


Why You Might Love This Role

You enjoy understanding how an industry works and building marketing that speaks directly to it.


You like owning the entire marketing engine , not just one channel.


You enjoy turning insight, content, and campaigns into measurable growth.


You want to help shape how the hospitality industry adopts the next generation of technology.


Why Join Us

You’ll be joining a modern AI-native product company that is helping reshape how hotels understand their guests, grow direct bookings, and operate more intelligently.


This is a rare opportunity to help introduce AI-powered guest engagement and marketing technology to the hospitality industry while building a marketing engine that drives real growth.


Your work will directly influence:

  • How the industry understands our product
  • How we position ourselves in the market
  • How we generate scalable demand


You won’t just run campaigns—you’ll help define how a new category of hospitality technology is introduced to the market and adopted by hotel leaders around the world.


If you’re energized by hospitality, great products, and building a marketing engine that truly moves the needle, we’d love to meet you.

Develop a deep understanding of the hotel ecosystem, including independent hotels, management companies, and brand-affiliated properties.


Stay closely connected to the needs and priorities of hotel decision-makers such as:

  • General Managers
  • Directors of Sales and Marketing
  • Revenue Managers
  • Digital marketing leaders
  • IT leaders


Use these insights to shape messaging, positioning, and campaigns that resonate with hotel operators.


Owning the Marketing Engine

Build and manage the full marketing funnel—from awareness through lead generation, nurturing, and conversion to sales.


Key areas include:

  • Demand generation strategy
  • SEO and digital acquisition
  • Email and lifecycle marketing
  • Webinars and industry events
  • Campaign development and execution


Your goal is to ensure marketing consistently generates qualified pipeline for the sales team.


Leading Blog and Thought Leadership Strategy

Own and grow the company’s blog and thought leadership presence to establish authority in the hospitality technology space and drive inbound demand.


This includes:

  • Writing and overseeing blog content focused on hotel industry trends and insights
  • Creating thought leadership around topics like AI in hospitality, guest engagement, and direct booking strategies
  • Developing SEO-driven blog content that attracts hotel decision-makers researching solutions
  • Implement AI Engine Optimization (AEO) strategies to ensure the company and its content are discoverable through AI agents like Copilot, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other emerging AI-driven discovery platforms.
  • Repurposing blog content into campaigns, LinkedIn posts, webinars, and sales materials


Creating Content That Speaks the Hotel Industry’s Language

Develop and oversee content that resonates with hospitality leaders, including:

  • Blog articles and thought leadership pieces
  • Industry guides and educational resources
  • Case studies and ROI stories
  • Campaign messaging and landing pages
  • Sales enablement materials


The goal is content that feels authentic, practical, and directly relevant to hotel operators , while positioning the company as a trusted voice in hospitality technology.


Becoming Deeply Fluent in the Product

You will develop strong product knowledge and become fluent in how the platform works.


This includes understanding:

  • How the product integrates into the hotel technology stack
  • The operational problems it solves for hotel teams
  • The value it creates for revenue growth and guest engagement


This fluency will help shape messaging, positioning, and product launches.


Partnering Closely with Sales

Marketing and sales alignment is critical in this role.


You will work closely with the sales team to:

  • Align on pipeline and growth targets
  • Develop campaigns that generate qualified opportunities
  • Support sales with content, messaging, and materials
  • Continuously improve lead quality and funnel performance


Using Data to Drive Decisions

Track performance across the funnel and continuously improve marketing efficiency.


You will analyze:

  • Lead generation performance
  • Campaign ROI
  • Funnel conversion metrics
  • Customer acquisition trends


Marketing should be measurable, predictable, and scalable.


Success in This Role

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to build a scalable marketing engine that consistently generates qualified pipeline.


Key outcomes include:

  • Growth in marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline
  • Consistent generation of qualified leads for the sales team
  • Increased inbound demand through SEO, blog content, and thought leadership
  • Strong campaign performance across webinars, events, and digital channels
  • Clear and compelling positioning that resonates with hotel decision-makers


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience marketing to hotels or within the hospitality technology ecosystem
  • Experience in B2B SaaS marketing and demand generation
  • Proven ability to generate qualified pipeline and measurable revenue impact
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, including blogs and thought leadership content
  • Ability to translate complex technology into clear, compelling messaging
  • Comfort operating both strategically and hands-on
  • Experience collaborating closely with sales teams in a pipeline-driven environment
  • Interest in AI-driven platforms, automation, and emerging technology transforming hospitality


Experience at or working with hospitality technology platforms such as hotel CRM, guest engagement, marketing automation, revenue management, or hotel operations platforms is highly valued.


Why You Might Love This Role

You enjoy understanding how an industry works and building marketing that speaks directly to it.


You like owning the entire marketing engine , not just one channel.


You enjoy turning insight, content, and campaigns into measurable growth.


You want to help shape how the hospitality industry adopts the next generation of technology.


Why Join Us

You’ll be joining a modern AI-native product company that is helping reshape how hotels understand their guests, grow direct bookings, and operate more intelligently.


This is a rare opportunity to help introduce AI-powered guest engagement and marketing technology to the hospitality industry while building a marketing engine that drives real growth.


Your work will directly influence:

  • How the industry understands our product
  • How we position ourselves in the market
  • How we generate scalable demand


You won’t just run campaigns—you’ll help define how a new category of hospitality technology is introduced to the market and adopted by hotel leaders around the world.


If you’re energized by hospitality, great products, and building a marketing engine that truly moves the needle, we’d love to meet you.

title: Brand Intern - Portuguese
description:
About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018.
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide.
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC.
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified.
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs.
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs.
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems.
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko.
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023.
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users.

Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.

BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Internship| Long-term | REMOTE

Key Responsibilities

  • Support regional brand and marketing campaigns, including planning, coordination, and execution
  • Assist in brand content creation and localization, such as social media posts, blogs, PR materials, and campaign assets
  • Participate in social media planning, including content ideas, posting calendars, campaign themes, and basic execution support
  • Help track and organize campaign performance and brand metrics (e.g. media coverage, social performance, basic analytics)
  • Maintain and update brand assets and content libraries
  • Conduct market and competitor research to support brand strategy and regional insights
  • Provide general support for cross-team collaboration and communication


Requirements

  • Undergraduate or graduate student majoring in Marketing, Communications or related field
  • Strong interest in branding, marketing, and global communications
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English (additional languages are needed)
  • Familiar with social media platforms (X/Twitter, Instagram, Youtube, TikTok, etc.)
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to manage multiple tasks
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-cultural environment
  • Basic knowledge of Web3 / crypto / fintech is a plus, but not required



Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Product Specialist
description:
About the Role:

CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support , Cyber Threat Takedown Operations , and Security Event Analysis . You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.


2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).
  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.
  • Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).
  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: Consultor Protheus Financeiro/Contábil
description:
Perfil – Consultor Protheus Financeiro/Contábil (com Reforma Tributária)


Resumo do perfil:


Consultor funcional sênior com forte domínio dos módulos Financeiro (SIGAFIN) e Contábil (SIGACTB) do Protheus, com visão integrada dos processos empresariais e experiência comprovada em projetos de reforma tributária (nova legislação brasileira) .



Principais características:


  • Experiência sólida em:


  • Contas a pagar/receber
  • Fluxo de caixa
  • Conciliação bancária
  • Contabilidade geral e fiscal


  • Conhecimento em:


  • Integrações entre módulos (PMS, compras, faturamento)
  • Fechamento contábil
  • Regras fiscais brasileiras
  • Adequação sistêmica à reforma tributária (CBS/IBS, mudanças fiscais e impactos no ERP)


  • Capacidade de:


  • Mapear processos e corrigir inconsistências
  • Ajustar parametrizações críticas
  • Apoiar auditorias e melhorias de controle
  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas fiscal, contábil e TI



Diferencial (agora obrigatório):


  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de reforma tributária (nova legislação)
  • Experiência em ambientes problemáticos (pós-implantação com inconsistências)

title: Performance Marketing Analyst
description:
We’re looking for a Paid Media Marketing Specialist to drive high-quality leads by creating, managing, and measuring Digital Marketing campaigns across Google, YouTube, social, and other relevant channels.


About us:

Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on, independent strategic thinker who brings deep expertise in running digital marketing programs and developing digital marketing assets (with our designer) within B2B SaaS organizations.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive, this isn’t the role for you. But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own:

  • Develop programs and strategies for customer acquisition, retention, and expansion through multiple channels, including search, PMAX, social, retargeting, content (written and video), and more.
  • Define KPIs and implement measurement, analytics, benchmarking, and reporting methods to gauge success for marketing channels, campaigns, and initiatives.
  • Drive continual improvements in lead conversion rates and revenue close rates.
  • Continue to scale our marketing efforts and take primary responsibility for exceeding our KPIs for each quarter.
  • Work closely with the overall Marketing team to define required assets such as content, images, video, etc.

title: Analista de Requisitos Pleno
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Se você gosta de atuar na interface entre negócio e tecnologia, facilitando rituais ágeis e garantindo a evolução contínua de processos e sistemas...

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Requisitos Pleno com visão analítica, perfil colaborativo e forte atuação com stakeholders.

Se você domina gestão de backlog, mapeamento de processos e especificação técnica em ambientes integrados, essa oportunidade é para você.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar como facilitador(a) dos rituais ágeis (daily, planning, review, retrospectiva), promovendo alinhamento entre os times
  • Intermediar a comunicação entre áreas de negócio, tecnologia e stakeholders externos
  • Monitorar o engajamento e a satisfação dos stakeholders, gerando reports executivos de acompanhamento
  • Identificar problemas, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e fluxos existentes
  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog de demandas de TI em conjunto com as áreas de negócio
  • Elaborar especificações técnicas para correções e evoluções de sistemas
  • Atuar no processo de homologação técnica de demandas e projetos
  • Apoiar na resolução de conflitos e incidentes, garantindo a continuidade operacional
  • Mapear e documentar processos, propondo melhorias contínuas
  • Sugerir e aplicar práticas ágeis adequadas ao contexto (Scrum, Kanban, Design Thinking)


Habilidades e Requisitos

  • Experiência como Analista de Requisitos, Negócios ou função similar
  • Forte atuação com gestão de backlog e priorização de demandas
  • Experiência em mapeamento e gestão de processos
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, Design Thinking)
  • Conhecimento em especificação técnica de sistemas
  • Experiência com integrações via SOAP e REST
  • Conhecimento básico em SQL Server
  • Experiência com reports e acompanhamento de indicadores
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas do Office 365
  • Conhecimento em ambientes com sistemas integrados (APIs e barramentos)


Diferencial

  • Experiência com sistemas de Consórcio ou produtos financeiros
  • Conhecimento em Azure e arquitetura de APIs/Webservices
  • Vivência com fluxos de vendas e processos comerciais
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos e de grande escala
  • Certificação ou atuação prévia como Scrum Master


Formato de trabalho

  • 100% REMOTO.


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Analista de Requisitos Pleno
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Se você gosta de atuar na interface entre negócio e tecnologia, facilitando rituais ágeis e garantindo a evolução contínua de processos e sistemas...

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Requisitos Pleno com visão analítica, perfil colaborativo e forte atuação com stakeholders.

Se você domina gestão de backlog, mapeamento de processos e especificação técnica em ambientes integrados, essa oportunidade é para você.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar como facilitador(a) dos rituais ágeis (daily, planning, review, retrospectiva), promovendo alinhamento entre os times
  • Intermediar a comunicação entre áreas de negócio, tecnologia e stakeholders externos
  • Monitorar o engajamento e a satisfação dos stakeholders, gerando reports executivos de acompanhamento
  • Identificar problemas, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e fluxos existentes
  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog de demandas de TI em conjunto com as áreas de negócio
  • Elaborar especificações técnicas para correções e evoluções de sistemas
  • Atuar no processo de homologação técnica de demandas e projetos
  • Apoiar na resolução de conflitos e incidentes, garantindo a continuidade operacional
  • Mapear e documentar processos, propondo melhorias contínuas
  • Sugerir e aplicar práticas ágeis adequadas ao contexto (Scrum, Kanban, Design Thinking)


Habilidades e Requisitos

  • Experiência como Analista de Requisitos, Negócios ou função similar
  • Forte atuação com gestão de backlog e priorização de demandas
  • Experiência em mapeamento e gestão de processos
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, Design Thinking)
  • Conhecimento em especificação técnica de sistemas
  • Experiência com integrações via SOAP e REST
  • Conhecimento básico em SQL Server
  • Experiência com reports e acompanhamento de indicadores
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas do Office 365

Diferencial

  • Vivência com fluxos de vendas e processos comerciais
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos complexos e de grande escala

title: Product Marketing Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own our product-led growth in partnership with our product team — someone who knows how to move the needle and own their outcomes.


About us:


Smarter Contact is the market-leading AI-powered communications platform for real estate professionals in the US market. Our SaaS products power tens of millions of conversations monthly, helping real estate professionals close more deals using text and voice.


If you’re used to depending on task queues, waiting for someone to tell you what to do, or only being reactive instead of mostly proactive — this isn’t the role for you.


But if you have a bias for execution and love taking ownership of outcomes — keep reading.


What You’ll Own


  • Drive our PLG initiatives by building campaigns that increase conversions, engagement, retention, upgrades, and cross-sells.
  • Own in-app messaging using tools like AppCues to onboard, convert, and activate users
  • Write high-impact messaging, value propositions, and product comparison landing pages that drive inbound conversion
  • Own and optimize in-app customer self-onboarding — reduce time-to-value, increase sign-to-trial and trial-to-paid conversion rates
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to align go-to-market efforts and drive measurable growth
  • Execute product launches and campaigns leading up to it, and bring a successful playbook you can leverage.
  • Build and manage internal and external product knowledge bases and communications for product updates
  • Be an active contributor in the development and management of customer advocacy programs such as user referral and/or affiliate programs.
  • Track campaign performance and report KPIs with precision — weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly
  • Partner with our success team to collect customer feedback through surveys, direct customer communications, and beta groups, and use it to create user stories and case studies.
  • Document campaign playbooks, and external and internal product trainings, using video (Loom), and upload to Trainual

title: Product Owner - Sênior
description:
Product Owner - Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio.
  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo “mão na massa”, orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital.
  • Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe).
  • Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional.
  • Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.
  • Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência.
  • Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade.
  • Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador.
  • Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência.
  • Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Consultor JD Edwards (JDE)
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo:

Consultor Funcional de Finanças JD Edwards (JDE) para integrar a área Digital & IT, responsável por desenhar, configurar e implementar soluções no módulo financeiro do JDE

O profissional atuará na transformação do ambiente de ERP, trabalhando em ambiente internacional e multicultural, colaborando com stakeholders e equipes globais para entregar soluções integradas alinhadas às necessidades do negócio.

Atuação abrangente nas etapas de Análise, Design, Codificação, Testes, Depuração e Suporte de aplicações corporativas.

Experiência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de aplicações de negócios complexas , atuando em diferentes áreas funcionais .

Condução de revisões técnicas de design e código , com foco em qualidade, experiência do usuário, desempenho, escalabilidade e evolução contínua das soluções .

Experiência em projetos de rollout e expansão de sistemas , garantindo a implantação estruturada e aderente às necessidades do negócio.

Vivência em ambientes multiculturais , atuando em colaboração com equipes globais e distribuídas .


*Inglês fluente imprescindível

100% Remoto

Contratação CLT obrigatória

SKILL

Requires experience

• Functional experience/ Financial, Sales, Procurement, Distribution)

• Involved in all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle

• Analysis, Design, Coding, Testing, Debugging and Support of business

• Work with complicated business applications across functional areas

• Manage design and code reviews with a focus on the best user experience, performance, scalability and future expansion

• Previous experience in Rollout

• Experience working with global teams


Mandatory Skills

• JD Edwards with Finacne functional experience(Financial, Sales, Procurement, Distribution)

• Well versed with Brazil localization (ex: Tax reform etc)

• Analyse requests to define functional and how the development will be implemented

• Ability to interact with business users, understand business processes, and engineer solutions to business problems

• Good communication and interpersonal skills

• Fluent English speaking and writing

• Fluent in Portuguese (local language of Brazil)

title: QA Engineer
description:
Senior QA Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil. Based)

Reports to: QA Engineer Senior

Type: Full-time

Salary : Competitive open to negotiate payment USD

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to join our growing technology team for an important Fintech Crypto Company. This role is crucial in ensuring the quality, performance, and reliability of our software products.

You will be responsible for executing manual and automated tests, identifying and documenting issues, and creating test scenarios aligned with business and technical requirements. You’ll also contribute to improving QA processes, CI/CD integration, and leveraging AI technologies to enhance automation efficiency and coverage.

This is a hands-on position — ideal for someone who enjoys both technical testing and process improvement , and who thrives in a collaborative, Agile environment.

⚙️ Key Responsibilities

  • Execute manual and automated tests to ensure software quality and performance.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases based on business requirements.
  • Create and manage functional and regression tests across multiple platforms.
  • Identify, document, and track issues and inconsistencies; collaborate with developers for timely resolution.
  • Support and promote best quality assurance practices within the development team.

title: Coordenador(a) de Trade Marketing
description:
Nosso cliente, uma empresa nacional de grande relevância no setor alimentício busca um(a) Coordenador(a) Trade Marketing para atuar na categoria de perecíveis, com foco em execução estratégica, gestão de PDV e suporte às equipes comercial e de marketing.


Responsabilidades


Planejamento & Estratégia

  • Desenvolver o plano anual de Trade Marketing para a categoria, alinhado às metas comerciais.
  • Analisar consumidor, mercado e tendências para propor ações que aumentem presença, visibilidade e frequência de compra.
  • Contribuir para definições de sortimento e estratégia por canal.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar o trabalho dos promotores, incluindo treinamento e direcionamento.
  • Apoiar ativações e campanhas junto ao time de Marketing.


Execução no PDV

  • Criar e implementar campanhas sazonais e materiais de ponto de venda (expositores, wobblers, comunicação de preço etc.).
  • Garantir padronização da execução nas lojas, monitorando rupturas, giro e competitividade.


Relacionamento com Varejo e Distribuição

  • Atuar como interface entre Comercial, Marketing e clientes, assegurando a implementação das ações de trade.
  • Negociar pontos extras, espaços de destaque e oportunidades de visibilidade.
  • Oferecer suporte à equipe de vendas com materiais, argumentos e treinamentos.


Análises & Indicadores

  • Acompanhar KPIs como sell-in, sell-out, ruptura, estoque, margem e participação de gôndola.
  • Produzir relatórios de desempenho por canal, cliente e SKU, trazendo insights para decisões comerciais.


Gestão de Budget

  • Administrar o orçamento de Trade Marketing, controlar investimentos, custos de materiais e verbas cooperadas.
  • Garantir compliance e acompanhamento de ROI.


Desenvolvimento de Categoria

  • Sugerir melhorias de exposição, embalagens, layout e diferenciação da categoria, considerando atributos como frescor, origem, certificações e valor agregado.


Requisitos

  • Formação em Marketing, Publicidade, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Trade Marketing, preferencialmente em alimentos perecíveis ou bens de consumo de alto giro.
  • Conhecimento de varejo, atacarejo e/ou food service.
  • Boa capacidade analítica e domínio de ferramentas como Excel e Power BI.
  • Perfil organizado, comunicativo e com habilidade de negociação e relacionamento.

title: ASM Team Lead
description:
Responsibilities

  • Lead the ASM team in daily coordination, prioritization, and escalation management.
  • Conduct triage for high visibility incidents, ensuring clear and timely communication with IT and Business.
  • Prioritize incidents and changes together with Business teams and IT capabilities.
  • Manage multi-vendor relationships, ensuring high performance and delivery quality.
  • Review ticket flow per portfolio and monitor RCA, weekly meetings, and performance metrics.
  • Translate business problems into technical requirements to accelerate resolution.
  • Perform code reviews and validate release packages and installation plans.
  • Coordinate operational artifacts: Stability Assessment, knowledge documents, KEDB, and Service Delivery reports.
  • Actively participate in Command Center and Incident/Problem/RCA Management forums.
  • Lead productivity initiatives and preventive maintenance programs.
  • Ensure compliance with processes and controls, applying ITIL/ SDLC best practices.
  • Present monthly results (KPIs/SLAs) to IT and Business leadership.
  • Support operational activities when necessary.


Success Indicators (KPIs)

  • Application availability and stability (uptime).
  • MTTR reduction and incident recurrence reduction.
  • SLA/SLO performance.
  • Change quality (low rollback/post release incident rate).
  • Operational efficiency: backlog reduction, productivity improvements, automation.
  • Internal customer satisfaction (IT/Business).


Mandatory Requirements

  • 8+ years leading IT solution delivery (ASM, AMS, Application Operations, or related fields).
  • Proven experience in critical incident management, prioritization, and executive communication.
  • Experience with multi-vendor environments and enterprise ecosystems (SAP, Oracle, Microsoft).
  • Strong knowledge of ITIL (Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge) and SDLC.
  • Ability to mentor teams, run operational ceremonies, and present operational metrics.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred (Computer Science, Systems, Engineering, Business/Finance).

title: Marketing Analyst
description:
Analista de Marketing


Faça parte da raposada! A InfoxHub é uma boutique de software focada em soluções personalizadas e criativas, onde cada projeto é único. Estamos em busca de uma raposa vermelha (nossa versão para quem está no nível júnior) com forte capacidade de organização e execução para integrar nosso bando na área de marketing.


Objetivo do cargo

Como Analista de Operações de Marketing Júnior, você vai atuar diretamente nos bastidores das nossas campanhas, garantindo que as rotinas e demandas fluam com precisão. Espera-se organização impecável para apoiar a equipe, senso de urgência para lidar com cronogramas e proatividade para manter as engrenagens do setor operando sem gargalos.


Sua Missão

Você será responsável por apoiar o ciclo operacional do marketing de forma integral, atuando com:


  • Gestão de Campanhas: Estruturar, subir e acompanhar o desempenho de campanhas em plataformas de mídia paga, especificamente Meta Ads e Google Ads.

title: Consultor SAP MM
description:
Requisitos Obrigatórios


Estamos em busca de um Consultor SAP MM para atuar em projetos estratégicos e sustentação de processos em ambiente industrial. A atuação envolverá melhorias e suporte nos módulos SAP MM com interface direta com áreas de Suprimentos, Logística e Operações. O candidato deve ter conhecimento em processos de compras, gestão de estoque, MRP , inventário e integrações logísticas, incluindo alçadas de aprovações. É essencial ter experiência ou vivência em SAP EWM apoiando processos de armazenagem, movimentação e controle de estoque. O levantamento de requisitos junto às áreas de negócio, desenho funcional e especificação técnica são partes importantes do trabalho, assim como o acompanhamento de integrações com outros módulos como FI, CO, SD e PP . Também é necessário atuar nas integrações com sistemas legados, fretes, importação e demais sistemas industriais, oferecendo suporte a testes integrados, go live e estabilização.


Requisitos Desejáveis


Ter pós-graduação completa é um diferencial relevante, assim como conhecimento funcional em EWM . Além disso, vivência em ambiente industrial, um perfil analítico, proativo e com boa comunicação são desejáveis. Capacidade de atuar próximo às áreas de negócio com visão de processo ponta a ponta é muito valorizada. Conhecimento em ABAP será considerado um diferencial relevante.


Resumo dos requisitos: SAP MM , SAP EWM , MRP , FI , CO , SD , PP , ABAP .

title: Oracle Cloud HCM Consultant (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Eexperience in Oracle HCM, preferably Fusion Cloud.
  • At least 1 real Oracle Fusion HCM project/rollout experience (mandatory).
  • Strong functional expertise in Oracle HCM Core HR (workforce structures, person/assignment, approvals, data quality).
  • Proficiency in Reporting (OTBI/BI Publisher) for building and maintaining essential reports and dashboards.
  • Experience with L2/L3 support, including incident management, root cause analysis, and documentation.
  • Familiarity with Release management, quarterly updates assessment, UAT coordination, and regression testing.
  • Comfortable with data loads (HDL/Spreadsheet Loader) and integration analysis (HCM Extracts/REST).
  • Professional working proficiency in English (mandatory).
  • Oracle certification in HCM (Core HR/Journeys/Reporting) is a plus.
  • Experience in the banking/financial services sector is valued.
  • Available to work hybrid in Lisbon- Portugal.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: SAP Basis
description:
Oportunidade SAP Internacional | 100% Remoto


SAP BASIS Consultant – 2 vagas


Se você tem experiência com administração e suporte de ambientes SAP complexos e busca atuar em um projeto internacional, essa oportunidade pode ser para você.


Modelo de atuação: 100% remoto

Contratação: PJ

Duração: 12 meses (grandes chances de extensão)

Início: Previsto a partir de Junho

Idioma: Inglês avançado / fluente

Horário: 12:00 PM às 21:00 PM (BRT)


O que você irá fazer?

Administrar e suportar paisagens SAP complexas (ECC, BI/BW, PI/PO, MII, Solution Manager)

Executar atividades de instalação, system refresh, system copy e client copy

Monitorar sistemas SAP para garantir alta disponibilidade e performance

Gerenciar Spool, Background Jobs, Print Management e integração com servidores de impressão

Realizar análises de performance e troubleshooting avançado em stacks ABAP e JAVA

Planejar e executar kernel patching, support package upgrades e upgrades de sistemas ABAP e JAVA com SUM

Trabalhar com banco de dados SAP HANA, garantindo estabilidade e integração com sistemas SAP

Implementar e manter SAP Solution Manager, incluindo Early Watch Alert (EWA) para sistemas S/4HANA

Atuar de forma integrada com times funcionais, técnicos e de infraestrutura

Requisitos

✔ 5 a 7 anos de experiência em suporte e administração de sistemas SAP

✔ Experiência comprovada com SAP ECC, BI/BW, PI/PO, MII e Solution Manager

✔ Experiência em ambientes SAP complexos e de grande porte

✔ Experiência em HANA Database por no mínimo 1 ano

✔ Experiência em upgrades de sistemas ABAP e JAVA utilizando SUM

✔ Forte conhecimento em Linux, redes, servidores de impressão, sistemas operacionais e storage

✔ Experiência obrigatória na implementação de Solman EWA para sistemas S/4HANA

✔ Inglês avançado ou fluente

Diferenciais

➕ Experiência em projetos de upgrade ou migração para S/4HANA

➕ Vivência em ambientes corporativos globais ou multi-país

➕ Experiência com operações AMS ou ambientes 24x7
